title: Asks before posting your photo
old_caption: Capricorn asked before posting, deleted the blinky one on request, and Leo got the good angle. Consent includes the camera roll. Which friend has your approval on photos?

title: Remembers your friends' names
old_caption: Rosa, Dev and Kit were not ready for Aquarius to remember their names AND their trip. Instant friend-group approval. Who passed the name test with your people?

title: Checks in when you go quiet
old_caption: No pressure to reply, just here when you need me. Pisces sent the kindest text and then cried at it, naturally. Who do you text first when you've been quiet a while?

title: Scrapes the frost off your car
old_caption: Taurus woke up to a clear windshield and an Aries holding a scraper at 7 AM. Winter romance is just chores done with a grin. Who's warming up your car this season?

title: Gives you the bigger half of the blanket
old_caption: A Taurus voluntarily gave up the bigger half of the blanket. Pisces dropped its tissue. Libra asked who they were. Would you share the big half? Be honest.

title: Shows up when they said
old_caption: Gemini said seven and knocked at seven. Aries is still processing. Being on time is a quiet way of saying you matter. Who in your group chat is always on the dot?

title: Warms your coat before you leave
old_caption: Capricorn put on its coat and found it toasty, because Cancer hung it by the heater an hour earlier. The stern face did not survive. Who would think of this for you?

title: Same with you around their friends
old_caption: No playing it cool in front of the crew: Leo pulled Sag in and introduced them with full pride. Same person, every room. Who's the proudest introducer you know?

title: Tilts the umbrella your way
old_caption: One umbrella, a lot of snow, and a Virgo with a little snow hat by the end. Worth it, apparently. Who would tilt it your way?

title: Notices your new haircut
old_caption: Scorpio said nothing about the new haircut. Libra noticed in two seconds anyway. Scorpio played it cool, then did a spin. What's the last change someone noticed right away?
